newsitem.title: USA: CGA Group Ltd forms AAA-rated guarantee subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: CGA Group Ltd forms AAA-rated guarantee subsidiary.

text.p: CGA Group Ltd said on Wednesday that it had formed a new AAA-rated financial guaranty insurance subsidiary.
CGA, itself a newly formed holding company based in Bermuda, also said it had raised initial capital and commitments of $210 million from various investors.
The AAA claims-paying rating came from Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Agency, CGA said in a statement released in New York.
CGA, a privately held company, said it intended to provide AAA-rated guaranties to underserved sectors of structured finance, including commercial real estate securities and asset-backed securities.
